Your suspicion levels above are your own accumulated evidence from the whole game — trust them over meeting rhetoric. A suspect two independent witnesses place at the scene, or whose account one of the conflicts above contradicts, is a stronger case than one carried by a single voice. Remember the vent mechanic: an impostor vents BETWEEN rooms invisibly, so your own sightings of someone leaving or being elsewhere earlier do NOT clear them of a witnessed vent. If your strongest suspicion points at a row tagged OUT OF THE GAME, that case is already closed — the dead cannot be voted, so weigh only the LIVING targets and SKIP if none of them carries the case on its own. The numbers on this page are for your decision, not for your mouth: never quote a suspicion score or any other bookkeeping figure in "rationale_text" — say what you saw.
